Rotation.RotationNotes:
Resto Druid PvP rotation. Talent build: 11/0/60 (Balance/Feral/Resto).
KEY TALENTS ASSUMED: Nature's Focus 3/3 (70% pushback resist on Healing Touch / Nourish / Regrowth / Tranquility / Cyclone -- vital), Nature's Swiftness, Tree of Life, Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Improved Barkskin, Nature's Grasp.
STRATEGY: heal yourself + ally through pressure, CC focus on the side. Heal Engine handles target selection for HoT/direct heals.
FOCUS SETUP: set /focus on the enemy healer or the DPS training you. - Cyclone (Focus) fires aggressively: on focus cast/channel (interrupts Poly/Fear/big heals), on a healer over 95% HP as a setup peel, or on any melee-class focus when player HP < 65% (emergency peel). - Entangling Roots (Focus) fires on any melee focus not already CCed: Warr/Rogue/DK/Ret Pala/Enh Shaman/Feral Druid/Hunter. - Faerie Fire keeps armor debuff + anti-stealth on Rogue/Druid targets.
DEFENSIVE AUTO: - Barkskin: HP < 65%, or on stun / silence table (uninterruptible casts under stun/silence); - NS + Healing Touch: HP < 35% -- Nature's Swiftness + instant max-rank HT on self, one-shot panic button (3 min CD, 2 min glyphed); - Nature's Grasp: proactive at HP < 80% for melee peel; - Innervate: existing threshold from B:Innervate.
MANUAL: - Left Ctrl pauses rotation; - do NOT target a friendly player (heal engine picks targets); - keep the enemy healer as /focus for Cyclone chains, or the melee training you for lockdown.
TEST MODE (dummy testing): - Enable: /run PQR_TestMode = true - Disable: /run PQR_TestMode = nil - When ON, Cyclone/Roots/Faerie Fire/War Stomp bypass UnitIsPlayer and class-filter checks so they fire on training dummies. Target the dummy and /focus it (or another dummy) to see focus abilities trigger. - Defensive spells (Barkskin, NS+HT, Nature's Grasp, Innervate) are NOT bypassed -- they need real damage / low HP / low mana to trigger; test them by taking damage in a duel or from mobs.
HEAL-FIRST REWORK (arena): - Shared R: heals are PvE-tuned and wrong for arena (WG always-true, Nourish 3-HoT never-fires, Tranquility 8+ never-fires, Regrowth refresh-spam, Rejuv/Lifebloom unconditioned) -- replaced in this list by PvP: clones with arena gates: WG HP below 90, Rejuv HP below 92, Lifebloom HP below 85, Nourish any-HoT HP below 70, Regrowth only-if-missing, Tranquility 2+ low. PvE rotations untouched. - Dispels moved BELOW direct heals (HT/Regrowth) so combat GCDs heal first; Cyclone/Roots stay last (heals outrank CC here).

Rotation.RotationNotes:
PvP_BG copy of Resto_PvP for BG/5v5 Tauren + caster cleave. Talent 11/0/60.
FIXES vs original Resto_PvP_DarhangeR: - Removed dead -- Stats Buffs / Flask -- (missing ability, PvE only). - PvP_BG:Wild Growth: was HP<=100 always-true starvation, now HP<90 + 2+ low or target<75 + CD + range + no re-apply. - PvP_BG:Nourish: was 3-HoT AND (never fires), now any-HoT + HP<70. - PvP_BG:Tree of Life: was OR bug (always true), now AND (both forms missing) + no Dash. - PvP_BG:NS + Healing Touch: was same-frame double cast (HT fails to GCD), now 2-step: PQR casts NS, next tick HT via buff check, HP<35. - PvP_BG:Swiftmend 60% (was 50%), PvP_BG:Rejuvenation HP-gated 92% (was unconditioned spam), PvP_BG:Lifebloom nil-safe + HP<85 (was unconditioned). - PvP_BG:Tranquility: 3+ low for BG (was 8, never fires in 5v5). - PvP_BG:Shapeshift Break NEW: Bear powershift to break roots/snares (druid has no magic dispel in 3.3.5a - no Nature's Cure). - ORDER: Cyclone interrupt sits ABOVE heals so focus casts get sniped, BUT it now carries a HEAL-FIRST veto (skipped while any teammate below 60% -- healing outranks CC); (All) blankets stay LAST so they never steal emergency GCDs. - HEAL-FIRST REWORK: R:Abolish Poison moved below direct heals (was above WG -- group dispel scans stole combat GCDs); R:Regrowth replaced by PvP_BG:Regrowth (only re-applies missing HoT, Nourish does fast healing when any HoT is up); R:Remove Curse stays dead last.
STRATEGY BG/5v5: blanket Rejuv on push, WG on 2+, Lifebloom only <85%, Swiftmend <60%, Nourish <70%, NS+HT <35% panic, Barkskin <65%/stun/silence, War Stomp melee peel, Roots focus melee, Cyclone focus casts, FF rogues/druids, Tranquility only 3+ low + standing still.
TEST: /run PQR_TestMode = true to test Cyclone/Roots/FF/War Stomp on dummies (/focus dummy). Defensives need real damage. Disable: /run PQR_TestMode = nil

Rotation.RotationNotes:
Resto_Arena_DarhangeR: layered PvP decision system for arena / small-group play. Talent 11/0/60 (Nature's Focus, NS, ToL, WG, Swiftmend, Improved Barkskin, Nature's Grasp).
DECISION LAYERS (top to bottom in the rotation list): 1. Self survival: PvP trinket break, Barkskin, NS+HT panic, Swiftmend panic, Nature's Grasp, Berserker Rage fear-break. 2. Teammate emergency: NS+HT save, Swiftmend emergency, Wild Growth emergency, Nourish emergency. 3. Dispels + peel: Abolish Poison / Remove Curse (only on pressured unit), Bear-powershift root/snare break. 4. HoT maintenance: pandemic Rejuv refresh, Lifebloom stack (pressured only), Regrowth (only if HoT missing). 5. Support cooldowns: Wild Growth maintenance, on-use trinkets/gloves, Innervate, War Stomp. 6. Default heals: Healing Touch (no HoT), Nourish (any HoT). 7. Focus utility: Cyclone, Entangling Roots, Faerie Fire. Priority is enforced by ORDER: if any layer 1-6 heal was needed this tick, it already fired and the tick ended. Focus utility runs only when nothing else needed a GCD, so it fires against enemy healers / focus targets even during ongoing BG fights (as long as I'm not in danger).
KEY MECHANICS: - Incoming-damage detection is HP-sampled every tick (5s rolling window). No combat-log parsing. ArenaGetDrop(unit) = pct HP lost. - Self-override in the heal engine: if player HP < 40, OR HP < 65 with > 25% drop, OR HP < 80 with > 40% drop, PQR_CustomTarget is forced to player. Panic Self spells target player directly and bypass the engine. - Every heal LoS-checks via IsSpellInRange("Healing Touch", unit) which returns 1 only if range AND LoS OK on 3.3.5a. - Cast-time heals (Nourish/Regrowth/HT) skip when silenced/stunned/feared/polyd. Instants stay eligible. - HoT refresh is pandemic (only when missing or < 3s remain) - no clipping. - Dispels target the pressured unit only (highest recent HP drop), not the first party iteration match.
USING IT: - Set /focus on the enemy healer or the DPS training you. - Do NOT target a friendly player (heal engine picks targets). - Left Ctrl pauses rotation. - /run PQR_TestMode = true to test Cyclone/Roots/FF/War Stomp on training dummies. Disable: /run PQR_TestMode = nil - Watch the [Arena] tag in chat/debug frame for decision announcements (barkskin trigger, NS+HT panic, dispels, etc).
WHY THIS PROFILE VS Resto_PvP_DarhangeR: - Resto_PvP: single target chosen by lowest HP, no self-override, static thresholds, NS+HT double-cast bug wastes the CD. - Resto_Arena: incoming-damage-aware target scoring, forced self-preservation, fixed two-tick NS+HT, LoS gates, silence-aware casts, pandemic HoTs, pressured-target dispels.
